content: Size of Fixed-size Array Length Fields The attribute size- OfArrayLengthFields of SOMEIPTransformationISignalProps defines the size of an length field generated by the SOME/IP transformer in front of all available fixed-size arrays in the ISignal . See also [constr_3282].

Size of Array Length Fields The attribute sizeOfAr- rayLengthFields of SOMEIPTransformationISignalProps defines the size of an length field generated by the SOME/IP transformer in front of all available fixed-size arrays or dynamic size arrays in the ISignal . See also [constr_3282].
